meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: You are a despicable man, Borya!
There are a lot of people here.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

выгнать.gloss: to kick out, to evict, to drive out

meanings.en: to kick out, to drive out

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

examples.trans: The main thing is, you keep him at home.
I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: the 'е' drops out in the other forms
short forms виноват / виновата / виноваты are used for 'it's my/your fault'

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?
I have no idea at all.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

уйти.gloss: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.en: to leave, to go away, to walk out

meanings.note: оставь мне кусок = save me a piece

examples.trans: I won't leave him on his own.

жалко.gloss: feel sorry for; it's a pity

meanings.note: impersonal predicate (+ dative of experiencer, + accusative/genitive)

examples.trans: I just feel sorry for him.

бывать.gloss: to happen, to be (sometimes); to visit

meanings.en: to happen, to exist, there can be
meanings.note: 3rd person бывает = there is / can be

examples.text: У мужчины бывает не только жена.
examples.trans: A man can have more than just a wife.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.
We need to do even more.

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.trans: Let's sum up the first week.

examples.trans: It's time for us to go.
